thread:
incident_bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in Okta token signature validation failures detected by auth-verify-prod (rate 450/min, error 401). Paging @sam_oncall. Automated throttles engaged.

sam_oncall: seeing it, paging SRE now. Confirming scope — is this hitting console login flows or API token verification?

kyle_sre: looks like both. Console login attempts show `invalid_signature` from `auth-verify` service; backend API calls using Okta-issued tokens also show 401s intermittently.

emma_dev: stack traces point to our JWKs verifier rejecting signatures after recent bump of `okta-jwt` lib (v2.3.0). Rolling back that change is in progress on canary.

sarah_prod: customer-impact: internal console for some orgs + customer SSO logins failing. Billing APIs still mostly OK. We should assume partial outage for SSO login.

ops_eng: coordinating with Okta support now — opened ticket 678910, they've acknowledged increased validations errors on their end. Asking for root cause and whether they rolled certs.

sam_oncall: action list: 1) rollback lib on canary (emma), 2) enable cached-JWKS fallback in auth-verify (kyle), 3) update status page (cs_lead), 4) notify escalations.

emma_dev: rollback finished on one canary pod, observed reduced failures for that instance. Deploying rollback across the fleet now. `kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-verify -n prod --selector=canary=false`

kyle_sre: toggled cached-JWKS fallback: set `VERIFY_ALLOW_STALE_JWKS=true` and increased cache TTL to 12h for emergency. Confirming circuits now accept previously cached keys.

cs_lead: posting interim status: "We are investigating login issues for customers using Okta SSO. Engineers are rolling back a recent verification library change and enabling JWKS caching as a mitigation." Will update in 15m. :spiral_calendar:

statusbot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1781234567 — Customers may experience login failures using Okta SSO.

sam_oncall: quick telemetry: error rate dropped ~60% on rollback canary, and ~45% overall after cache fallback. Still seeing residual 401s from edge locations us-west-2.

emma_dev: investigating client-time skew? logs show `signature_alg_mismatch` on some tokens, looks like Okta might be returning tokens signed with different alg than advertised in JWKS. Pinging Okta support with sample tokens.

ops_eng: Okta answered — they rotated a signing key earlier but their JWKS propagation lagged in some regions, causing signature validation to fail for our verifier during short window. They are marking as incident on their side.

sarah_prod: customer impact summary for pager/upstream: - Affected customers: ~12 orgs with SSO logins via Okta. - Impact: 15-40% login failures during window. - Duration (so far): ~18m and ongoing mitigation.

sam_oncall: next steps: continue rollout rollback + keep cached-JWKS enabled for 1h after Okta confirms propagation. Prepare post-incident follow-up: add retries for JWKS fetch and better fallback metrics.

emma_dev: rolling out rollback completed at +28m. `auth-verify` error rate back to baseline in most regions. Leaving cached-JWKS on for 1h as discussed.

kyle_sre: added a temporary alert suppression to avoid noisy paging while we monitor recovery, documented in incident runbook.

cs_lead: CS notified affected customers with preliminary note. Will send postmortem summary once we have root cause and timeline.

sam_oncall: declaring severity P2 -> P1? I'd keep P1 for now until Okta confirms full propagation and all failures resolved. Any objections?

sarah_prod: agree keep P1 for 1 more hour. We need complete confirmation and a timeline before lowering.

ops_eng: Okta confirmed full JWKS propagation at +62m. They recommend short-lived clients fetch fresh JWKS on 5s backoff.

emma_dev: removing cached-JWKS emergency flag in 45m and instrumenting metrics for `jwks_fallback_used` and `jwks_propagation_errors`. Also adding unit tests for alg mismatch handling.

sam_oncall: last check: auth-verify 5xx/401 rates back to normal for 30m. Closing active pager at +2h. Will file incident for postmortem.

incident_bot: Incident closed by @sam_oncall. Summary: transient Okta JWKS propagation lag after key rotation caused signature validation failures across our auth verifier. Mitigations: rollback of verification lib, enabled cached-JWKS fallback, coordinated with Okta support.

cs_lead: Postmortem owner assigned: @sarah_prod. Action items: (1) implement JWKS fetch retry/backoff, (2) add metric/alert for JWKS mismatch spike, (3) document emergency fallback TTL policy, (4) update playbook to contact Okta account rep during key rotations.

sam_oncall: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups in #postmortems. :thumbsup:
